version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Google Merchant Center integration that can make high-impact account changes, but its artifacts consistently require user approval, scoped connections, and credential safeguards.

dimensions.detail: Network access, OAuth login, and Maton CLI/API use are proportionate to the integration. The raw HTTP fallback requires a long-lived Maton API key, but the artifact limits it to environments without the CLI and gives clear handling guidance.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is via a pinned Maton CLI release using npm or Homebrew, with optional pinned SDK packages; no embedded executable payloads or hidden install-time scripts were found in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill is write-capable and includes automation, functions, triggers, and notification/webhook examples, but it repeatedly instructs agents to default to read/list calls and obtain explicit approval with specific resource identifiers before writes, connection creation, deployments, persistent forwarding, or local --exec automation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth credentials, hosted functions, triggers, destinations, and Merchant Center notification subscriptions can persist beyond a session, but the artifact discloses this and requires user confirmation, least-privilege scoping, and cleanup/revocation guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The purpose is coherent: manage Google Merchant Center products, inventory, data sources, reports, promotions, notifications, conversions, and account settings through Maton-authenticated API calls.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let an agent administer Google Merchant Center through Maton. Review every proposed write, webhook, trigger, hosted function, or raw API-key use carefully, confirm the exact account and resource IDs, and revoke unused connections or automations when the task is finished.
